```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(osmextract)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson"))

land_use_raw <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "AmendmenttoMasterPlan2019LandUselayer.geojson"))

pbf_file <- here("data", "raw", "malaysia-singapore-brunei-261113.osm.pbf")

area_center <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK", "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)" )
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")
```

```{r}
hub_jurong <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_tampines <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_woodlands <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hubs <- bind_rows(hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)

hubs_4326 <- hubs %>% 
  st_transform(4326)

rm(hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)
```

```{r}
jurong_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "JURONG EAST") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
jurong_bbox <- st_bbox(jurong_sf)

tampines_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "TAMPINES") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
tampines_bbox <- st_bbox(tampines_sf)

woodlands_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "WOODLANDS") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
woodlands_bbox <- st_bbox(woodlands_sf)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
interested_features <- list(
  "amenity" = c(
    "bar", "biergarten", "pub", "nightclub",
    "restaurant", "cafe", "fast_food", "food_court",
    "cinema", "theatre", "arts_centre", "community_centre", "library"
  ),
  "shop" = c(
    "mall", "department_store", "clothes", "fashion", "shoes", "books", "electronics",
    "supermarket", "convenience", "bakery", "butcher", "greengrocer"
  ),
  "leisure" = c(
    "park", "sports_centre", "fitness_centre", "playground"
  )
)

raw_points <- oe_read(
  file_path = pbf_file,
  layer = "points",
  extra_tags = c("amenity", "shop", "leisure"),
  quiet = TRUE
)

raw_polygons <- oe_read(
  file_path = pbf_file,
  layer = "multipolygons",
  extra_tags = c("amenity", "shop", "leisure"),
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  st_centroid(quiet = TRUE)

poi_collection <- bind_rows(raw_points, raw_polygons) %>%
  filter(
    amenity %in% interested_features$amenity |
    shop %in% interested_features$shop |
    leisure %in% interested_features$leisure
  ) %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  distinct(osm_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
poi_collection_hubs <- poi_collection %>%
  st_intersection(hubs_4326 %>% select(PLN_AREA_N)) %>%
  mutate(hub = str_to_title(PLN_AREA_N)) %>%
  select(-PLN_AREA_N)

poi_collection_hubs <- poi_collection_hubs %>% 
  select(name, amenity, shop, leisure, hub, geometry)
```

```{r}
pois_classified <- poi_collection_hubs %>%
  mutate(
    poi_category = case_when(
      amenity %in% c("bar", "biergarten", "pub", "nightclub") ~ "Nightlife",
      amenity %in% c("restaurant", "cafe", "fast_food", "food_court") ~ "Dining",
      amenity %in% c("cinema", "theatre", "arts_centre") | 
        leisure %in% c("park", "sports_centre", "fitness_centre", "playground") ~ "Family_Leisure",
      shop %in% c("mall", "department_store", "clothes", "fashion", "shoes", "books", "electronics") ~ "Retail_Shopping",
      shop %in% c("supermarket", "convenience", "bakery", "butcher", "greengrocer") ~ "Daily_Needs",
      amenity %in% c("community_centre", "library") ~ "Community",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>% 
  filter(poi_category != "Other") %>% 
  select(
    poi_category, 
    geometry, hub, name
    ) %>% 
  arrange(poi_category)

poi_counts <- pois_classified %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hub, poi_category) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
    )
```

```{r}
hub_areas <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  st_transform(3414) %>% 
  group_by(PLN_AREA_N) %>% 
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(geometry), 
    .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1000000,
    hub = str_to_title(PLN_AREA_N)
  ) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

poi_density <- poi_counts %>%
  left_join(hub_areas, by = "hub") %>%
  mutate(
    density_per_km2 = count / area_km2
  )
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
land_use_3414 <- land_use_raw %>%
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_transform(3414)

rm(land_use_raw)

land_use_hubs <- st_intersection(
  land_use_3414, hubs %>% select(PLN_AREA_N)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(hub = str_to_title(PLN_AREA_N))
```

```{r}
land_use_hubs <- land_use_hubs %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1000000)

land_use_summary_raw <- land_use_hubs %>%
  group_by(hub, LU_DESC) %>%
  summarise(
    total_land_area = sum(area_km2), 
    .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
  group_by(hub) %>%
  mutate(
    total_hub_area = sum(total_land_area),
    percentage = (total_land_area / total_hub_area) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(hub, desc(percentage))
```

```{r}
land_use_summary_clean <- land_use_hubs %>%
  mutate(
    land_category = case_when(
      LU_DESC %in% c("RESIDENTIAL", "RESIDENTIAL WITH COMMERCIAL AT 1ST STOREY", 
                     "COMMERCIAL & RESIDENTIAL", "WHITE") ~ "Residential& Mixed-Use",
      LU_DESC %in% c("COMMERCIAL", "HOTEL", "BUSINESS 1", "BUSINESS 2", 
                     "BUSINESS PARK", "BUSINESS 1 - WHITE", "BUSINESS 2 - WHITE", 
                     "BUSINESS PARK - WHITE") ~ "Commercial/Business",
      LU_DESC %in% c("PARK", "OPEN SPACE", "SPORTS & RECREATION", "BEACH AREA") ~ "Leisure/Green",
      LU_DESC %in% c("EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION", "CIVIC & COMMUNITY INSTITUTION", 
                     "PLACE OF WORSHIP", "HEALTH & MEDICAL CARE",
                     "COMMERCIAL / INSTITUTION", "RESIDENTIAL / INSTITUTION") ~ "Community/Institutional",
      TRUE ~ "Other")
  ) %>%
  group_by(hub, land_category) %>%
  summarise(total_land_area = sum(area_km2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(hub) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (total_land_area / sum(total_land_area)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

land_use_summary_clean$land_category <- factor(
  land_use_summary_clean$land_category,
  levels = c("Residential& Mixed-Use", "Commercial/Business", 
             "Leisure/Green", "Community/Institutional", "Other")
)
```


```{r save-report-outputs}
# Figures and tables for the report (docs/report/report.Rmd embeds these files)
source(here("R", "map_theme.R"))   # line_colours, line_chart_theme
source(here("R", "save_fig.R"))

# Land-use mix of the three regional centres
p_land_use <- ggplot(land_use_summary_clean,
                     aes(x = hub, y = percentage / 100, fill = land_category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Land use") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of land area",
       title = "Land-use mix of the three regional centres",
       caption = "Data: URA Master Plan 2019 Land Use layer (amended).") +
  line_chart_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"))
p_land_use
save_fig(p_land_use, "hub_land_use", width = 8, height = 4.5)

# Density of weekend-relevant points of interest
p_poi <- ggplot(poi_density,
                aes(x = poi_category, y = density_per_km2, fill = hub)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = line_colours[1:3], name = "Regional centre") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("_", " ", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "POIs per km²",
       title = "Density of points of interest in the regional centres",
       caption = "Data: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Geofabrik extract.") +
  line_chart_theme
p_poi
save_fig(p_poi, "hub_poi_density", width = 8, height = 4.5)

save_tab(land_use_summary_clean, "hub_land_use")
save_tab(poi_density, "hub_poi_density")
```
